en.answer: In this situation, you cannot activate the effect of <<11768>>. Monster Tokens are removed from the field instead of being sent to the Graveyard, and Pendulum Monsters are placed face-up in the Extra Deck instead of being sent to the Graveyard.
en.question: If <<11768>> destroys an opponent's Pendulum Monster or Monster Token by battle, can the effect of <<11768>> which targets and destroys an opponent's monster be activated?
